snippet.title: Subnautica - Mobile Pre-Order Trailer (iOS & Android)
snippet.description:
Descend into the depths of an underwater alien world filled with wonder and peril!

Subnautica is coming to iOS and Android on July 8th, 2025. Pre-order or pre-register today and get 10% off the launch price.

 ✨ Pre-Order & Pre-Register Now ✨

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/subnautica/id6478639011 
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unknownworlds.subnautica
